verdict.rationale: Vast.ai is a GPU rental/compute marketplace, not a data-analytics or BI product; there is no user data corpus within the product for it to analyze and generate AI insights from. Its 'agent' features (vastai skill, CLI, SDK) let AI assistants operate the platform (search offers, launch instances) but do not generate insights/suggestions from a user's own data — this is a category mismatch, not a missing feature.
